description: Detection rules and response playbooks for data quality, ML, business, and privacy threats

data_quality_threats.impact: Missing data degrades model accuracy, creates gaps in reports, and can violate regulatory completeness requirements.
recommended_actions: Investigate root cause (data pipeline failure? optional field?)
Apply appropriate imputation based on distribution
Create missing indicator if pattern is informative
Drop column if > 60% missing and non-critical
data_quality_threats.business_narrative: Missing values in '{column}' affect {pct}% of records. If left untreated, reports using this column will underrepresent {pct}% of your data, potentially missing ${impact} in insights.

severity_rules.critical: > 5% duplicates OR duplicates in ID columns

data_quality_threats.impact: Duplicates inflate aggregates (revenue, counts), bias ML models by overweighting repeated patterns, and waste storage.
recommended_actions: Review duplicate groups to verify they are true duplicates
Keep the most recent/complete record
Merge complementary fields from duplicate records
Investigate ingestion pipeline for the source of duplication
data_quality_threats.business_narrative: Found {count} duplicate records ({pct}%). Revenue reports may be inflated by up to ${inflated_amount}. Customer counts are overstated by {dup_customers}.

data_quality_threats.detection_rule: Similar but not identical category values (fuzzy match > 85%)

severity_rules.critical: Inconsistency in key business dimensions (region, product, customer type)

data_quality_threats.impact: Fragments business segments. 'New York' vs 'new york' vs 'NY' creates 3 segments instead of 1.
recommended_actions: Standardize to a canonical form (uppercase, lowercase, title case)
Create a mapping dictionary for known variations
Apply fuzzy matching to merge similar categories
Add validation rules at data entry points
data_quality_threats.business_narrative: Found {count} inconsistent categories in '{column}' — what should be {expected} segments is fragmented into {actual} segments, reducing the reliability of segmentation analysis.

data_quality_threats.detection_rule: Column contains both numeric and string values

severity_rules.critical: Column that should be numeric contains strings (e.g., '1000', 'N/A', '$1,000')

data_quality_threats.impact: Prevents numeric operations, causes type errors in ML pipelines, and produces incorrect aggregations.
recommended_actions: Identify and extract the dominant type
Convert string representations to proper types
Handle special values ('N/A', 'NULL', '-') as missing
Remove formatting characters ($, %, commas)
data_quality_threats.business_narrative: Column '{column}' contains mixed types — {pct_numeric}% numeric, {pct_string}% string. Aggregations (SUM, AVG) will fail or produce incorrect results.

severity_rules.critical: Outliers in financial/KPI columns affecting business metrics
severity_rules.medium: Outliers in feature columns for ML models

data_quality_threats.impact: Outliers skew averages, distort model training, and can trigger false alarms in monitoring systems.
recommended_actions: Verify if outliers are valid (legitimate extreme values) or errors
Winsorize financial data at 1st/99th percentile
Apply RobustScaler for ML pipelines
Flag impossible values (negative age, future dates) for review
data_quality_threats.business_narrative: {count} outliers detected in '{column}'. These extreme values shift the mean by {shift}%, potentially misleading average-based KPIs and dashboards.

ml_threats.detection_rule: Feature has suspiciously high correlation with target (> 0.95) OR feature contains information not available at prediction time
ml_threats.impact: Model appears to have near-perfect accuracy during training but fails completely in production. The most dangerous ML threat.
detection_patterns: timestamp of feature is after timestamp of target event
feature is a direct transformation of the target
recommended_actions: IMMEDIATELY remove leaked features
Verify temporal ordering of all features vs target
Check if any feature is derived from the target
Re-evaluate model performance after removal
ml_threats.business_narrative: ⚠️ CRITICAL: '{column}' has {corr} correlation with the target — this is almost certainly target leakage. Your model's {accuracy}% accuracy is an illusion. In production, performance will drop to near-random.

ml_threats.detection_rule: Target variable has minority class < 20% of total
ml_threats.impact: Model learns to always predict the majority class. A fraud detector with 99% accuracy that never catches fraud is useless.
recommended_actions: Use SMOTE or ADASYN for oversampling minority class
Use class_weight='balanced' in model parameters
Use appropriate metrics (F1, AUC-ROC, Precision-Recall) instead of accuracy
Consider ensemble methods designed for imbalanced data
ml_threats.business_narrative: Target variable '{column}' is severely imbalanced: {majority}% vs {minority}%. A naive model achieving {majority}% accuracy by always predicting the majority class would be useless for detecting {minority_label}.

ml_threats.impact: Redundant features inflate model complexity, cause unstable coefficients in linear models, and slow training.
recommended_actions: Drop one of the correlated pair (keep the more interpretable one)
Create a composite feature (PCA or weighted average)
Use regularization (L1/Lasso) to automatically select relevant features
Check VIF (Variance Inflation Factor) > 10 as confirmation
ml_threats.business_narrative: Features '{col1}' and '{col2}' have {corr} correlation — they carry nearly identical information. Keeping both wastes model capacity and can cause unstable predictions.

ml_threats.detection_rule: Feature has near-zero variance OR very low mutual information with target
ml_threats.impact: Adds noise without signal, increases overfitting risk, and slows inference.
recommended_actions: Remove near-zero variance features
Calculate mutual information or chi-squared test with target
Consider feature selection (SelectKBest, RFE)
Monitor model performance with/without the feature
ml_threats.business_narrative: Feature '{column}' has near-zero predictive power (mutual information: {mi_score}). Including it adds noise and increases model complexity without improving predictions.

privacy_threats.detection_rule: Column values match email regex pattern
privacy_threats.impact: PII exposure risk. Violation of GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations. Potential fines and reputation damage.
recommended_actions: Hash or tokenize email addresses
Remove email column if not needed for analysis
Apply domain-only extraction if email domain is needed
Add governance tag: PII-Email

privacy_threats.detection_rule: Column values match phone number patterns
privacy_threats.impact: PII exposure. Phone numbers can be used for identity theft and social engineering attacks.
recommended_actions: Mask phone numbers (show only last 4 digits)
Remove phone column if not needed
Hash for linkage purposes only
Add governance tag: PII-Phone

privacy_threats.detection_rule: Column values match SSN/national ID patterns
privacy_threats.impact: Highest sensitivity PII. Data breach with SSNs can result in multi-million dollar fines and criminal liability.
recommended_actions: IMMEDIATELY flag for security review
Remove from dataset — SSNs should NEVER be in analytics data
Report to data governance team
Add governance tag: PII-CRITICAL-SSN

privacy_threats.detection_rule: Column values match credit card patterns (13-16 digits, Luhn valid)
privacy_threats.impact: PCI-DSS violation. Credit card data in analytics systems is a compliance emergency.
recommended_actions: IMMEDIATELY remove from dataset
Report to compliance/security team
Investigate how card numbers entered the analytics pipeline
Add governance tag: PII-CRITICAL-PCI

business_threats.detection_rule: customer_id or equivalent has duplicate values with different attributes
business_threats.impact: Revenue reports inflated. Customer counts overstated. Marketing spend wasted on ghost customers.
recommended_actions: Merge duplicate customer records
Keep the most recently updated record
Consolidate transaction history under single ID
Fix the source system creating duplicates

business_threats.detection_rule: Revenue/sales columns contain zeros, negatives, or nulls in records that should have values
business_threats.impact: Revenue underreported. Financial projections unreliable. Investor metrics inaccurate.
recommended_actions: Identify patterns in broken records (specific dates? specific products?)
Cross-reference with source systems
Flag for finance team review
Separate returns/refunds from true $0 transactions

business_threats.detection_rule: Most recent date in dataset is > 90 days old OR date range has unexplained gaps
business_threats.impact: Decisions based on outdated data. Seasonal patterns missed. Trend analysis unreliable.
recommended_actions: Verify data pipeline is running correctly
Check for ingestion failures in the gap periods
Add recency warnings to any insights generated
Recommend fresh data pull before strategic decisions
